Schedule Consultation A Gentler Chemical Peel What is BioRePeelCI3? BioRePeelCI3 is an incredible liquid made of trichloracetic acid (TCA), amino acids, and vitamins that provides tighter, smoother skin. The difference between BioRePeelCI3 and other chemical peels is that BioRePeelCI3 is not photosensitive and can be used all year round to address pigment, lines, and texture! Younger-Looking Skin What are the benefits of BioRePeelCI3? BioRePeelCI3 is ideal for adults looking to smooth out or prevent the formation of new wrinkles , reduce the effects of sun damage, shrink oversized pores, melasma or eliminate blemishes and acne scars. BioRePeelCI3 can also help improve skin tone and texture, lessen stretch marks, rehydrate the skin, and reduce skin laxity. Application of this gentle and non-invasive chemical peel is associated with little to no pain. BioRePeelCI3 provides immediate improvement with almost no downtime. Smooth away years of wrinkles and blemishes Am I a good candidate for BioRePeelCI3? One of the gentlest chemical peels on the market, BioRePeelCI3 provides spectacular results. Since it is so gentle, this peel is perfect for adults of all ages, skin tones, and skin types who want tighter, smoother, and more even-toned skin. Individuals who are pregnant or breastfeeding should check with a doctor before receiving any kind of cosmetic treatment. BioRePeelCI3 may not be recommended if you have a skin infection, an open wound near the target treatment site, or very sensitive skin. Check with your primary care doctor or one of our licensed aesthetic medical providers to make sure BioRePeelCI3 is a good fit for you . Schedule Consultation A Comfortable, Clean Experience Your BioRePeelCI3 Procedure To begin, your licensed aesthetic medical provider will clean your skin in the area to be treated. Next, they will administer the BioRePeelCI3 liquid using a gentle massaging technique. You may experience a slight tingling sensation, but there is little to no pain associated with this procedure . Once applied, the excess liquid will be wiped off. A moisturizing cream will then be applied to promote the healing process. Gentle Yet Effective BioRePeelCI3 Recovery Since BioRePeelCI3 is made to be gentle and cause less damage , your skin will have minimal peeling afterward! You may experience light peeling in areas where the skin is thicker, but peeling is dramatically less than that caused by other chemical treatments. You may also experience some redness or slight inflammation for the first few days after treatment, but these symptoms will clear up by the end of the week. After treatment, our Londonderry BioRePeelCI3 patients will be ready to return to most normal activities. Avoid spending time in direct sunlight, and always apply sunscreen to the treated areas for the first week after treatment. Sweat can irritate the treated areas, so it is also recommended that you avoid strenuous physical activity that could irritate your healing skin. Enhancing Your Complexion BioRePeelCI3 Results With BioRePeelCI3 chemical peels, you will be able to see instant improvement of the skin in the treated areas, leaving with an immediate glow. Full results take about a week to show up when any residual redness and possible flaking will be resolved. At that time, you will see noticeably smoother, tighter, blemish-free skin. Each of our Londonderry BioRePeelCI3 patients and treatment is unique. At your consultation, you will have the opportunity to discuss your individualized treatment plan. BioRePeelCI3 peels are permanent . However, because the skin is continuously changing and aging, it is recommended that you schedule a touch-up treatment every year to maintain your improved complexion. Schedule your consultation with us today and begin your journey to smoother, healthier-looking skin. BioRePeelCI3 Frequently Asked Questions Will it hurt? The application of BioRePeelCI3 may cause a slight tingling sensation but is virtually painless. You may experience mild sensitivity and inflammation during the first week of recovery. What are the risks? There are not any common risks associated with BioRePeelCI3. Does my insurance cover it? Insurance does not cover BioRePeelCI3 or any other chemical peels . We are happy to discuss any questions about pricing during your consultation.
